name: AutoWiFi BITS
one_line: Automatically and silently logs BITS Pilani students into the FortiGate campus Wi-Fi captive portal in the background when joining the network or when sessions expire.
users: BITS Pilani students authenticating with their own campus ID and password

features.name: Captive portal detection and FortiGate login
features.detail: Check http://neverssl.com (fallback http://connectivitycheck.gstatic.com/generate_204); if redirected or body contains https://fw.bits-pilani.ac.in:8090/fgtauth?<magic>, POST credentials to https://fw.bits-pilani.ac.in:8090/ using configurable form fields (defaults: username, password, magic, 4Tredir).

features.name: Already-logged-in detection and session keepalive
features.detail: Do nothing when the check URL loads normally without fgtauth; after login, poll the returned keepalive URL (https://fw.bits-pilani.ac.in:8090/keepalive?<token>) every 5 minutes and trigger a fresh login if keepalive fails.

features.name: Campus network detection and host-pinned TLS
features.detail: Treat DNS resolution failure for fw.bits-pilani.ac.in as off-campus and do nothing; verify HTTPS on port 8090 against the standard trust store first and pin fw.bits-pilani.ac.in only if an OS store fails, never disabling TLS verification globally.

features.name: Retry backoff and quiet failure notifications
features.detail: Retry failed checks or logins at 5 s, 15 s, 60 s, then every 5 minutes; send at most one quiet notification per hour on rejected credentials (pausing retries until updated), 3 consecutive non-credential failures, or unexpected portal form changes, and never notify on success.

features.name: OS secure credential storage
features.detail: Store credentials only in macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Android Keystore, or Linux Secret Service API via go-keyring (falling back to ~/.config/autowifi-bits/credentials with mode 600 and a one-time warning if Secret Service is unavailable), never in code or logs.

features.name: macOS background agent
features.detail: Cross-compiled Go single binary for macOS 12+ running silently at login with an optional menu-bar icon and no windows.

features.name: Windows background tray app
features.detail: Cross-compiled Go single binary for Windows 10+ running at login with a system tray icon.

features.name: Android background app
features.detail: Kotlin app for Android 8.0 (API 26)+ triggered on Wi-Fi connect via ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback plus a 15-minute WorkManager periodic check, requesting battery-optimization exemption once and distributed as an APK via GitHub Releases.

features.name: iOS Apple Shortcuts automation and guide
features.detail: Apple Shortcut triggered when joining specified campus Wi-Fi SSIDs, storing credentials locally in Shortcut Text actions with instructions noting iCloud sync and recommending iCloud Advanced Data Protection.

features.name: Shared protocol spec, JSON test suite, and local mock portal
features.detail: One written protocol specification and shared JSON test cases run by both Go and Kotlin implementations against a local mock FortiGate portal that issues per-visit magic tokens and exposes keepalive and logout endpoints.

features.name: Campus portal capture diagnostic command
features.detail: Diagnostic command that inspects an active captive portal page and prints the form action URL and input field names (never values) to confirm campus portal configuration.

features.name: GitHub Releases and static download page
features.detail: GitHub Pages static site linking to GitHub Releases binaries/APK and documenting unsigned-app bypass steps (macOS Gatekeeper, Windows SmartScreen, Android APK sideloading) and a pre-release campus verification checklist.

features.name: Linux desktop support
features.detail: Cross-compiled Go single binary for Ubuntu 22.04+ with tray icon, start-at-login support, and Secret Service or mode-600 credential storage.

features.name: Manual log-in-now trigger
features.detail: Tray menu or app button allowing the student to trigger an immediate captive portal check and login.

features.name: Auto-update check
features.detail: Periodic check against GitHub Releases to inform the user when a newer version is available.

features.name: Code signing and notarization
features.detail: Sign and notarize desktop binaries for macOS Gatekeeper and Windows SmartScreen in a future release.

user_flows: First-time setup: Student downloads the binary, APK, or Apple Shortcut from GitHub Pages/Releases, completes OS unsigned-app prompts if needed, saves campus ID and password into the OS secure store (or iOS Shortcut Text actions), and enables login startup or grants Android battery-optimization exemption.

Silent background login: On network change, Wi-Fi join, or periodic timer, the client requests the check URL; if redirected to fgtauth, it extracts the magic token, submits credentials over HTTPS to fw.bits-pilani.ac.in:8090, and polls the returned keepalive URL every 5 minutes.
Off-campus or active session: If fw.bits-pilani.ac.in fails DNS resolution or the check URL returns normally without fgtauth, the client exits the check quietly with no notification.

Error handling and backoff: On network/portal errors the client retries at 5 s, 15 s, 60 s, then every 5 minutes; on wrong credentials or changed form it emits at most one quiet notification per hour and pauses retries on rejected credentials until updated.
On-campus capture verification: Student runs the capture diagnostic command while the captive portal is displayed to inspect the form action URL and field names before finalizing defaults.
integrations: BITS Pilani FortiGate captive portal (https://fw.bits-pilani.ac.in:8090 fgtauth, login POST, keepalive, logout)
OS secure credential stores (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Linux Secret Service API, Android Keystore)

stack.language: Go (desktop: macOS, Windows, Linux) and Kotlin (Android)
stack.framework: Cross-compiled Go single binary with tray/autostart wrappers; Android SDK (API 26+) with WorkManager; Apple Shortcuts
stack.database: None (OS secure credential stores and local mode-600 Linux fallback file only)
packages: Shared JSON protocol test suite + local Go/Kotlin mock HTTP/TLS portal

non_goals: Backend servers, central databases, user accounts, or hosted web applications
Storing user credentials in source code, logs, Git repository, or the static download page
SSID-based triggering on macOS, Windows, Linux, or Android
Code signing or notarization for the initial release
open_questions: What are the exact FortiGate portal action URL and form field names on campus (to be confirmed using the capture diagnostic command against the configurable defaults)?
What are the exact BITS campus Wi-Fi SSID names shown in iPhone Wi-Fi settings for the iOS Shortcuts automation guide?
Is the *.bits-pilani.ac.in certificate on port 8090 trusted by default macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android trust stores, or does any OS require pinning fw.bits-pilani.ac.in?
